resolution.summary: Production readiness requires selective retrieval, live source applicability and freshness, safe candidate-only behavior, bounded concurrency/cache/cancellation/failure recovery, adversarial document/path safety, cross-platform install and real host tests, representative held-out quality/cost comparisons against strong Markdown and same encoder controls with predefined gates, and an opt-in pilot with diagnostics and rollback. Existing bounded 18-run result showed no quality gain and extra cost; passing CI alone is insufficient. Proposed gates are targets, not achieved results. No rollout authorized.
